title: Day 2 · Florence
logline: Tuesday. The travelogue's second day. Florence, Oregon, forty miles from home, captioned like Marrakesh. A gas station. The dog in the window. The strip commits to the bit.

panels.composition: A gas station on 101 in Florence, drawn with the awe of a foreign capital: low light, a pump, a Sitka spruce. The Datsun. BARNABY's head out the window.
panels.caption: DAY 2 · FLORENCE. The light here is different. Nobody knows my name.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a coastal gas station beneath Sitka spruce drawn with the grandeur of a foreign capital, a rusted small car at the pump with a dog's head out the window
image.notes: Caption in a travelogue face. The bit: forty miles as abroad.

panels.composition: WOOD at the pump. A local in a cap, nodding. Wood nodding back, gravely, as to a foreign customs officer.
panels.caption: A local. We communicate by nodding. It is enough.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a thin man at a gas pump exchanging a grave nod with a local man in a cap

panels.composition: The receipt. FLORENCE OR. Wood holding it like a passport stamp.
panels.caption: Proof of passage.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, close-up of a man holding a gas receipt reverently like a passport stamp

panels.composition: The Datsun on 101 south, the sea, the dog. The caption box, huge. Forty miles.
panels.caption: South. Into the unknown. Coos Bay by nightfall, God willing.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a rusted small car driving south on a coastal highway with the sea beyond and a dog's head out the window, a large caption box over the sky
